title: Account for acquisition of property, plant, and equipment through debt and equity issuances

items.concept: Initial recognition of specialized equipment at PV of a noninterest-bearing note (market rate known); cash down payment; full subsequent measurement schedule (effective interest); period-end discount amortization JEs; maturity settlement of face

Number-variant twin: acquisition of equipment with cash down payment and noninterest-bearing note measured at PV (market 8%); full effective-interest subsequent measurement schedule; period-end amortization JEs; face payment at maturity

(1) Noninterest note when FV of equipment is determinable and market rate is unknown—impute effective rate from FV and face; full subsequent measurement schedule; period-end JEs; maturity. (2) Acquisition of equipment by issuing publicly traded common stock (FV of securities more clearly evident)
Classification / measurement — when equipment acquired with a note is recorded at face vs PV; when stock is used, measurement uses more clearly evident FV
